assumptions.statement: Rummager is the only application currently using api-redis.
The previous network isolation requirement (different vDC) that necessitated a separate Redis instance is no longer relevant in the current AWS environment.
assumptions.quote: This was traditionally the case because Rummager lived in a different vDC to redis-1/redis-2, but this is no longer a concern in AWS.

assumptions.statement: The backend-redis instance has sufficient capacity to handle the additional load from Rummager without performance degradation.
